method: Actual app with owned whole starting saves and actual simulation/autosave; same single RAF wrapped for callback CPU; renderer.render wrapped for synchronous submission and optional asynchronous disjoint-safe GPU timer. Camera commands injected once/s. Not presented FPS or physical Android.

metrics.kind: RAF callback intervals and synchronous JS/core/render-submit duration; NOT presented FPS or GPU time

heap.note: Potentially shared/quantized JS heap estimate; not tab-exclusive retained memory, GPU bytes or a leak proof

rows.notes: No refills or state injection during timed sample; fixture setup and inspector/readout excluded from callback CPU
